title: Gapped group testing

problem.name: Gapped group testing
problem.statement_latex: An unknown $S\subseteq[n]$ is promised to have $|S|\le k$ or $|S|\ge k+d$. Given subset-intersection tests $T\mapsto[T\cap S\ne\varnothing]$, distinguish the cases with bounded error.
problem.statement_text: An unknown $S\subseteq[n]$ is promised to have $|S|\le k$ or $|S|\ge k+d$. Given subset-intersection tests $T\mapsto[T\cap S\ne\varnothing]$, distinguish the cases with bounded error.
